descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S24 Typed encounter text saves with no save tap: survives a tab switch and a reload, both modes, no bleed

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both. (UAT 3.3; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Standard fixture ({hospitalPatient}, {snfResident})

When Type into each chart's encounter box without pressing Save & Extract or Generate; go to Pre-Round and back; reload; then check the other chart

Then Each typed text is still in its own chart's box after the reload and never appears in the other chart

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. cp1 mustContain QA16-TYPED-H and mustNotContain QA16-TYPED-N. cp2 mustContain QA16-TYPED-N and mustNotContain QA16-TYPED-H. cp3 mustContain QA16-TYPED-H and mustNotContain QA16-TYPED-N (U1 same-day save, U8). Whether and when this text then appears as a prior entry is Q8 / S10 / S11

Where it ran: dev unit U07; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S24

Typed encounter text saves with no save tap: survives a tab switch and a reload, both modes, no bleed

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (generated/tc16s24/verdict.json). Agent: 46 turns, 174 s, $0.32.

Plan: unit U07 (#7, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Typed encounter text autosaves. Legacy seed; it types into both Encounter boxes (autosaved), which every later part on these charts would see.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #7, U07; checked: yes): Pass — typed encounter text survives reload in both modes and after switching back; no transcript row invented
